violations.text: Raw animal foods were not stored properly to prevent cross-contamination. Inspector observed cheese being stored in the same container at beef. Except when combined as ingredients, different types of raw animal foods must be separated from each other during storage by using separate equipment or arranging each type of food in equipment so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2026

Potatoes were observed held out of temperature control at 63 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per interview with PIC, potatoes have been left out 1 hour prior. PIC moved to refrigerator at time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2026

Food was observed held at 43-48 degrees Fahrenheit in the prep unit next to the grill. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per person in charge, food had been in the prep unit since the day prior. Food was voluntarily disposed of (see attached disposal form). The prep unit was taken out of service and must not be used until it can maintain an internal food temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. Prep unit must be repaired/replaced/adjusted. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2024
